nodes.title: Stand the cylinder
nodes.description: Stand the clean, dry 25 mL graduated cylinder upright on the bench.

feedback.retry: Review Stand the cylinder and try again.

nodes.title: Pour to below the line
nodes.description: Pour the hard-water sample from its bottle into the cylinder until the level is just below the {{config.targetVolumeMl}} mL line.

feedback.success: Pour to below the line complete.
feedback.retry: Review Pour to below the line and try again.

nodes.title: Fill the dropping pipette
nodes.description: Draw sample from the small beaker into the dropping pipette.

feedback.retry: Review Fill the dropping pipette and try again.

nodes.title: Add drops to the line
nodes.description: Hold the pipette over the cylinder and add sample a drop at a time until, at eye level, the bottom of the meniscus sits on the line. If it goes past, draw the excess back up with the pipette.

validation.label: Add drops to the line was recorded.

feedback.success: Add drops to the line complete.
feedback.retry: Review Add drops to the line and try again.

nodes.title: Read the volume
nodes.description: With your eye level with the meniscus, read the volume at the bottom of the curve to the nearest 0.1 mL and record it.

feedback.retry: Review Read the volume and try again.
